objective: Reconcile each discussion outcome into versioned plans, designs, specifications, dependencies, and affected ARs, reopening narrowly when guidance is stale, contradictory, incomplete, or changes scope.
assumptions: Coordinator owns task revisions and AR transitions
AWG preserves prior versions and public provenance
Private discussion content is represented only by bounded typed references
unknowns: Projects may use different artifact storage formats
invariants: Every required artifact has revision-bound before and after references
Every change has an impact and affected-AR classification
Unresolved contradictions or stale guidance cannot be silently continued
Scope changes reopen affected ARs and require another discussion
Prior versions and provenance remain referenced
Reconciliation approval does not prove implementation correctness
acceptance_predicates: Stale, contradictory, incomplete, and silently-continued fixtures fail closed
A targeted reopen identifies affected ARs and requires discussion

formalization.scope: finite discussion reconciliation and reopen outcomes
